description: Read today's Outlook calendar directly from your local desktop without creating Azure App registrations or OAuth client secrets. Uses AppleScript on macOS and PowerShell COM automation on Windows. Zero network access required.
tagline: Local Outlook calendar reader via AppleScript & PowerShell.
highlights: No Azure App registration or Microsoft tenant admin consent
100% offline with zero external network requests
whatsNew: Native desktop script backend with zero registration overhead.
